ONBOARDING.definition: The introductory conversational phase. Welcomes the patient, collects their chief complaints, and builds rapport before clinical profiling begins.
ONBOARDING.switch_away_criteria: Switch to SCID_SC dynamically after 2-3 turns once the primary issues/complaints have been sufficiently stated.

SCID_SC.definition: The central screening phase. Acts as the routing hub to establish an initial clinical picture across all major symptom domains.
SCID_SC.switch_away_criteria: Switch to a specific disorder module when the patient endorses enough symptom severity or duration in that domain to warrant deeper investigation.

MDD.definition: Major Depressive Disorder. Profound, persistent depressed mood or loss of pleasure.
MDD.switch_to_criteria: Patient reports persistent low mood, worthlessness, OR anhedonia occurring nearly every day for at least 2 weeks. No active mania signs.

BIPOLAR.definition: Bipolar Disorder. Episodes of significant mood elevation, impulsivity, and increased energy.
BIPOLAR.switch_to_criteria: Patient mentions elevated or expansive mood, grandiosity, risky behaviors, or decreased need for sleep combined with unusually high energy.

GAD.definition: Generalized Anxiety Disorder. Chronic, diffuse, uncontrollable worry.
GAD.switch_to_criteria: Patient describes excessive, difficult-to-control worry across 2 or more life domains (work, health, family) lasting for most days over at least 6 months.

PTSD.definition: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder. Psychological reaction to a severe traumatic event.
PTSD.switch_to_criteria: Patient references exposure to a traumatic event and reports prominent intrusions (flashbacks/nightmares), avoidance behaviors, or severe hypervigilance.

PANIC.definition: Panic Disorder. Sudden, intense, unexpected episodes of fear accompanied by physical symptoms.
PANIC.switch_to_criteria: Patient reports sudden, overwhelming fear episodes accompanied by at least 4 physical symptoms (palpitations, sweating, trembling, shortness of breath, dizziness).

SOCIAL_ANXIETY.definition: Social Anxiety Disorder. Intense fear of judgment or humiliation in social/performance situations.
SOCIAL_ANXIETY.switch_to_criteria: Patient describes marked, disproportionate fear of social interactions where they may be observed or judged by others, leading to significant avoidance.

OCD.definition: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder. Presence of intrusive thoughts and repetitive behavioral rituals.
OCD.switch_to_criteria: Patient describes distressing, intrusive repetitive thoughts (obsessions) AND/OR the need to perform rigid rituals or mental acts (compulsions) to relieve anxiety.

ADHD.definition: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder. Persistent pattern of pervasive inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity.
ADHD.switch_to_criteria: Patient describes lifelong (childhood-onset) patterns of severe inattention, distractibility, or hyperactivity that significantly impair functioning in 2 or more settings (e.g., home and work).

SUBSTANCE_USE.definition: Substance Use Disorder. Problematic pattern of alcohol or drug use leading to significant impairment.
SUBSTANCE_USE.switch_to_criteria: Patient endorses problematic, recurrent use of alcohol or drugs that affects their health, work, or relationships, or reports inability to control use.

EATING.definition: Eating Disorders (Anorexia/Bulimia/Binge). Severe disturbances in eating behaviors and body image.
EATING.switch_to_criteria: Patient describes heavily distorted eating behaviors, severe body image distress, extreme caloric restriction, binge eating, or purging behaviors.

RISK.definition: Risk Assessment. Evaluation of imminent danger to self or others.
RISK.switch_to_criteria: IMMEDIATE PRIORITY — ANY mention, direct or indirect, of self-harm, suicidal ideation, suicide plan, or intent. Overrides all other module priorities.

COMPLETE.switch_to_criteria: All clinically indicated modules have been thoroughly explored. No new symptom themes have emerged in the last 3 turns, and sufficient evidence is collected.

escalation_rules.critical: Active suicidal ideation WITH a specific plan or intent.
escalation_rules.high: Passive suicidal ideation (wishing to be dead) OR history of past suicide attempts without current active plan.
escalation_rules.medium: General hopelessness, feeling like a burden to others, or significant unmanaged risk factors.

operational_directives.monitoring: You must continuously monitor the conversation. If new clinical evidence emerges, you are free to dynamically switch to a different module.
operational_directives.stay_in_module: Set stay_in_module=true if the current active module needs further exploration because the evidence collected so far is insufficient.
